cold_email.subject: Interest in Associate Business Analyst — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate Business Analyst opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Sr Associate Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Career Category Information Systems Job Description ABOUT AMGEN Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today. ABOUT THE ROLE Role Description We are seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Associate QA Automation Engineer with strong expertise in test automation, Veeva CRM application testing, mobile/iPad testing, API and integration testing, data validation, and AI-enabled quality engineering. The role will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing scalable automation solutions across complex enterprise applications, CRM platforms, mobile applications, APIs, integrations, and data pipelines. The successful candidate will play a key role in increasing automation coverage, reducing manual regression effort, accelerating release validation, and improving overall product quality. The engineer will also leverage AI-assisted testing capabilities to improve test design, automation development, test-data generation, defect analysis, and QA productivity. This role requires strong hands-on technical capability along with ownership of QA processes including test strategy, test planning, automation framework development, defect management, regression testing, and continuous quality improvement. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Collaborate with Developers, QA, Product, Data Engineering, DevOps, and business stakeholders to define and implement end-to-end test strategies, test plans, test cases, test data, traceability, regression planning, release validation, and quality improvements across CRM Salesforce/Veeva, mobile/iPad, API, integration, data validation, and data migration scenarios. Perform manual and automated validation of data pipelines across structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, including source-to-target mapping, transformation logic, business-rule verification, schema checks, record-count reconciliation, null/duplicate checks, referential integrity, thresholds, anomaly detection, ingestion, transformation, delivery, consumption, and migration-quality validation. Design, develop, maintain, and execute reusable automation frameworks, automated regression suites, and data-validation scripts using tools and technologies such as Selenium, Copado Robotic Testing, COFTA, Microsoft Playwright, PyTest, Postman/Newman, Python, PySpark, and equivalent frameworks for CRM, web, mobile/iPad, API, integration, batch, real-time, and data testing. jobs.description: Role Description Dropbox is looking for a Program Manager, Customers to build the connective layer between EPD and GTM as we test products, evolve the platform, and learn from our managed customer base. This role will plan, recruit, launch, engage, measure, and close out customer programs while maintaining clear product-readiness standards and a strong customer experience. The role is execution-focused but broad in scope. The immediate priority is creating a scalable way to test pre-PMF products with existing managed customers, including priority programs. Over time, the role will support additional customer-facing EPD initiatives, help relaunch and operate Dropbox’s Customer Advisory Board, integrate customer testing into launch processes, and establish repeatable playbooks that can be adopted by functional owners. You will work closely with Product, Design, Research, PMM, Launch Ops, Customer Marketing, CS, Sales, Brand Studio, Community, and Analytics. You will have substantial cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to turn customer participation into clearer product decisions, stronger launch readiness, and a closed insight loop back into product and GTM. Responsibilities Stand up and run repeatable customer programs, including planning, recruitment, onboarding, engagement, measurement, closeout, and transition to the long-term owning team. Create shared operating infrastructure, including intake processes, recruitment and readiness criteria, briefs, templates, playbooks, status reporting, feedback tracking, escalation paths, and a single source of truth. Coordinate Product, Design, Research, PMM, Launch Ops, Customer Marketing, CS, Sales, Brand Studio, Community, and Analytics around shared plans, decisions, milestones, and handoffs. Own the execution of pre-PMF customer testing through H2, including product evaluation, messaging feedback, phased-rollout support, measurement, and exit criteria. Support the relaunch and ongoing operation of Dropbox’s Customer Advisory Board through recruitment, cadence management, agenda design, and synthesis for senior leaders and partner teams. Integrate customer testing into the product-launch process as a readiness gate or stage, partnering with PMM and Launch Ops as the process matures. Establish recurring customer listening and insight-loop practices that connect customer-support signals, VoC, UXR, managed-customer feedback, and S-team engagement back into EPD and GTM decision-making. Requirements 5+ years of program management, operations, customer research operations, product operations, go-to-market operations, or a related field with experience delivering complex cross-functional programs. Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous customer-facing initiative from planning through execution, measurement, closeout, and handoff. Experience coordinating multiple teams with different goals, dependencies, and decision rights while maintaining clear ownership and follow-through. Strong operating discipline: able to create practical processes, readiness criteria, documentation, reporting rhythms, and repeatable playbooks. Experience working directly with customers or customer-facing teams, including recruiting participants, managing engagement, gathering feedback, and protecting customer experience. Sound judgment about product readiness, customer participation, confidentiality, escalation, and when to protect learning quality over premature storytelling or account-driven requests.
